result.title: Constraint Dependency Graph Retrieval for Compliance Detection on Long SKILL Documents
result.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents carry out business operations under enterprise documents we refer to as SKILL documents, which take the form of standard operating procedures (SOPs) that state the conditions to verify and the actions to take before an operation proceeds. Long, densely cross-referenced SKILL documents exceed the context budget of small deployed auditors. Similarity-based retrieval then brings in irrelevant rules while omitting mandatory prerequisites, and the two-stage audit policy provides no trainable signal for the retrieval stage. We present SkillCDG, a compliance detection framework that reformulates each SKILL document as a constraint dependency graph, shifting rule retrieval from similarity-based matching to closure-based selection under the deployment's context budget. Each atomic rule is anchored to its source text span as a graph node, and mandatory prerequisite relations form the sole edge type. Policy-generated retrieval keywords activate seed rules, whose dependency closure yields a compact and conditionally complete rule context within that budget. The same graph also supports a joint optimization scheme. The retrieval stage is trained with group-relative policy optimization using a verifiable reward that combines output-format validity with downstream verdict correctness, with closure non-emptiness serving as a validity gate, while selective on-policy distillation concentrates teacher supervision on high-entropy reasoning tokens, with verdict and termination tokens always included, to improve verdict accuracy. Experiments on three enterprise datasets and two public benchmarks show that SkillCDG improves accuracy and F1 over the full-document and retrieval-based baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 SkillCDG，将长 SOP 类 SKILL 文档改写为约束依赖图，把规则检索从相似度匹配改为在上下文预算下的依赖闭包选取，并用带可验证奖励的 group-relative 策略优化训练检索阶段，同时以选择性 on-policy 蒸馏加强高熵推理 token 的监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「闭包式选取」要求所选内容条件完备（不遗漏必要前提），可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与任务必要信息保留的标准；高熵 token 的选择性蒸馏线索也可能对应轨迹监督与贡献分配，但纯文本领域、无 latent 状态，属较远借鉴。
